description: Query the audit ledger for governance entries. Search by operation name or retrieve recent entries. Returns hash-chained audit trail with MAI classification context.

exclude_actors.description: Additional actor IDs or prefixes (prefix matched) to exclude from results. Useful for silencing a specific noisy integration without suppress_noise.

suppress_noise.description: When true, filters out known high-volume infrastructure actors (legacy-* prefix, SYSTEM) and lifecycle-only operations (mcp-reinitialize, mcp-initialize) from results. The full forensic ledger is never mutated — this is a view-layer filter only.

name: audit_pipeline
